change_summary: Standing live-vs-model drift reconciliation shipped per docs/live_drift_reconciliation.md: quant/live_drift_reconciliation.py builds a daily ledger (data/live_pilot/live_drift/) comparing every moomoo long position against the backtest fill model (fill_drift, realized vs modeled return, trajectory_drift), bucketed core/sleeve/discretionary_legacy, idempotent per (asof, position_id), with a 10-consecutive-session core-drift alert wired into run.py logging. First live run reconciled 7/11 positions and immediately surfaced real measurement facts: blended avg_cost vs first-fill entry_date fakes +38% fill drift on scaled-in positions (now flagged suspect_multi_fill and excluded from aggregates), 4 positions predate warehouse coverage, and no live position carries a core tag yet. 8 tests. Strategy behavior untouched (observe-only; before==after baseline).

hypothesis: Alpha blocker: the system cannot detect live-vs-model drift of the core stack because no surface reconciles moomoo realized positions against backtest-model expectations; a daily live-drift ledger (fill drift + trajectory drift per position, bucketed core/sleeve/discretionary) makes silent edge or execution decay visible per docs/live_drift_reconciliation.md.
notes: This closes blindspot #1 from the 2026-07-06 system review: replay parity proves replays match, but nothing watched whether the LIVE book tracks the model. v1 covers open-position fill and trajectory drift; exit-side reconciliation is gated on a materialized moomoo deal-history surface (>=20 closed trades, recorded reopen condition). Known v1.1 calibration item: warehouse adjustment convention vs broker raw fills may add a constant offset; the alert watches consecutive deterioration so a constant offset does not false-fire.
